summary.headline: Astrological Codices 20–23
summary.text: Catalog entries 20–23 describe Byzantine astrological materials: Nicephorus Gregoras on placing stars in the astrolabe spider, verses on stars and the twelve zodiac signs, lunar elections for surgery, travel, commerce, secrecy, and clothing, and Heliodorus’s apotelesma with an earthquake omen for the Sun’s entry into Aries. Codex ownership and manuscript details include Johannes Dokeianos/Docianus and diagrams for Gregoras’s work.
